notes.title: Speed Meets Firepower – Meet Fireboat Archer
notes.content:
[h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/b2e57b6e3898eaa121fc5b06ba856a5f8ea80d85.png"][/img][b]Ahoy, Seafarers![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Welcome to our final entry in our [i]Meet the Fleet [/i]series before [b]Seafarer: The Ship Sim[/b] sets sail into Early Access on October 7![/p][p]We’ve explored the rugged workhorses of [b]Crescentport Logistics[/b], enforced order with the police ships [b]Rigid[/b] and [b]Density[/b], and introduced [b]Lancer[/b], the first of our firefighting specialists.[/p][p]Now, it’s time to reveal [b]the last piece of the starting fleet[/b]: [b]Fireboat Archer[/b].[/p][p]When a blaze ignites on the seas and in ports, speed and precision make all the difference. [b]Archer[/b] is built to deliver both – combining the agility of a speed boat with raw firefighting power to extinguish flames in ports and coastal zones before disaster spreads.[/p][p]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/87cd553544072c350cc9daf035710f85fdad0d76.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]🚤 Meet Archer[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Fireboat Archer brings [b]rapid response capability[/b] to your [b]Tide Guard[/b] fleet. Perfect for emergencies in tight and crowded spaces, this nimble vessel hits the scene fast and hard.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/e73b92c672feda0573a9f9c57adba3a24c3ff116.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]⚠️ Compact, Fast, Essential[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Larger ships may bring heavy-duty solutions, but when you need quick intervention, [b]Archer is first on the scene[/b] – small, sharp, and laser-focused on saving structures from fire.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/577e91e8dda3f97ba96ba6f198a2b489229b59df.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🗺️ Early Access Roadmap on the Horizon[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]With the fleet revealed and the horizon in sight, we’re almost ready to launch. Are you?[/p][p]Soon, it’s finally time to reveal our Early Access Roadmap plans. Stay tuned![/p][p]📌 Make sure you [b]add Seafarer: The Ship Sim to your Steam Wishlist[/b] and join us on the journey:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][url="https://www.instagram.com/seafarergame"]https://www.instagram.com/seafarergame[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://www.facebook.com/SeafarerSim/"]https://www.facebook.com/SeafarerSim/[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://x.com/SeafarerGame"]https://x.com/SeafarerGame[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://www.threads.net/@seafarergame"]https://www.threads.net/@seafarergame[/url][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][url="https://www.tiktok.com/@astragon_entertainment"]https://www.tiktok.com/@astragon_entertainment[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://discord.gg/astragon"]https://discord.gg/astragon[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://www.seafarergame.com"]https://www.seafarergame.com[/url]   [/p][/*][/list][p]The countdown to launch is on - see you on the horizon on October 7, Seafarer.

notes.title: Built for Fighting Flames – Meet Firefighting Ship Lancer
notes.content:
[h3]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/4589a6c66187135fa1614c2986a93465587da093.png"][/img][b]Ahoy, Seafarers![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We’re back with another post for our [i]Meet the Fleet [/i]series. We’ve already had a look at the two ships of the Crescentport Logistics faction and at the two police ships, Rigid and Density, so now it’s time to move onto a different part of the Tide Guard faction work: Firefighting.[/p][p]When flames erupt on the open water, speed and precision make the difference. Enter the [b]Firefighting Ship Lancer[/b] – a compact powerhouse designed to battle the toughest infernos and hold its own against the challenges of the high seas.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/e437e79b5c29da1bffa13af2925ae455745d54f7.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]🚨 Meet Lancer[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Lancer is a [b]specialized firefighting vessel[/b] equipped for rapid response and resilience. Whether you’re quenching fires on cargo ships, dousing flames at offshore structures, or rushing to emergency calls in turbulent waters, Lancer is your frontline defender.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/653a8a926d43ec9e929fb81b5489d554511b68a6.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🔥 Purpose-Built for Emergencies[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Lancer focuses on one mission: [b]fight fire fast and fight it effectively[/b]. When every second counts, this ship delivers reliability, control, and raw firefighting power. Fire at sea is unforgiving – but so is Lancer. Ready to brave the elements, this ship will be a crucial part of your Tide Guard fleet when disaster strikes.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/f6ca6991ae3028ac847931c5e31286f13fdfcd89.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]👀 More on the Horizon[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Want more behind-the-scenes updates from [i]Seafarer: The Ship Sim[/i]? Follow us and join the crew on your favorite platforms:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][url="https://www.instagram.com/seafarergame"]https://www.instagram.com/seafarergame[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://www.facebook.com/SeafarerSim/"]https://www.facebook.com/SeafarerSim/[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://x.com/SeafarerGame"]https://x.com/SeafarerGame[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://www.threads.net/@seafarergame"]https://www.threads.net/@seafarergame[/url][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][url="https://www.tiktok.com/@astragon_entertainment"]https://www.tiktok.com/@astragon_entertainment[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://discord.gg/astragon"]https://discord.gg/astragon[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://www.seafarergame.com"]https://www.seafarergame.com[/url]  [/p][/*][/list][p]📌 Don’t forget to [b]add Seafarer: The Ship Sim to your Steam Wishlist[/b]!

notes.title: Mark your Calendars, Seafarers – We have a Release Date!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/efb5e528a0f593248a0acf3cae004bdfe1d72be2.png"][/img][/p][p][h3][b]Ahoy Seafarers,[/b] [/h3] [/p][p]We’re thrilled to finally reveal the official release date for [b]Seafarer: The Ship Sim[/b]:

🗓️ [b]October 7, 2025[/b] – that’s when we’ll launch into Early Access! We know – we initially said Summer 2025, and we hate having to ask for a little more patience. But we want to be fully transparent:  We’ve decided to take a few more weeks to polish core features and refine the overall gameplay experience. These extra weeks will help us ensure that every voyage feels rewarding from the very first step aboard.  [/p][p][/p][h3][b]📺 Watch the official EA Release Date Reveal trailer here:[/b] [/h3][previewyoutube="sjt4FfmlTvg;full"][/previewyoutube][h3]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/8781d49afa2991365ad6233d8c512af5c4c2f6c2.png"][/img][/h3][h3][b]Closed Beta is Underway![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We’re already putting this time to good use with our [b]Closed Beta[/b], now live! This is your chance to play Seafarer early, share feedback, and help us fine-tune the game ahead of launch.

[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/343e2d3b90c4fc4d6c0b1143630cd488588ac5b8.png"][/img][/h3][h3][b]Meet us at gamescom![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We’re also heading to [b]gamescom 2025[/b], where Seafarer will be [b]publicly playable for the first time[/b]. If you’re attending, stop by, play the game, and meet the team – we’d love to see you![/p][p] [/p][p]Thank you again for your continued support and excitement. With your help during the beta, we’re making Seafarer the best it can be.[/p][p]We’re nearly there – and we can’t wait to welcome you aboard this October.[/p][p][/p][p]See you on deck,[/p][p][b]Your Seafarer Team 🚣‍♀️[/b][/p]

notes.title: Ready to Patrol – Meet Police Boat Rigid
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/4fdb84f01eff7083f640cca2df2c742bede392b8.png"][/img]
[b]Ahoy Seafarers![/b]

The sea needs order – and someone to enforce it. Are you ready for the job?[/p][p]In this week’s [i]Meet the Fleet[/i], we’re introducing the [b]police boat Rigid[/b], by far the smallest but also most agile vessel in [i]Seafarer[/i].   [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/c7609dab2f3eb3ba9abce65473951c17cb30402a.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]🚨 Meet Rigid[/b][/h3][p]
Rigid may be compact, but she’s definitely an essential vessel for your [b]Tide Guard[/b] career. She’s designed for quick response, agile maneuvering, and tight patrol routes. Whether you are monitoring incoming vessels, checking documents, or dashing across the harbor to investigate, Rigid gets you there fast.[/p][p]It’s all about practicality, speed and focus – with just the essential equipment for getting the job done.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/ebc50b7195ae48f32b9c3c71669f24a79ac36048.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]🔧 Inflatable Precision[/b][/h3][p]Inspired by real-world RIBs (Rigid Inflatable Boats) used in coastal law enforcement, this boat is designed with utility and simplicity in mind. That does not mean there’s nothing to interact with, though![/p][p]You’ll have direct access to the propulsion engine for repairs and maintenance, and lifebuoys, the anchor and a search light are just within arm’s reach.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/e17996f831d9a8d4b0baab711e3b9b07d995b1eb.png"][/img][/p][h3]🕵️‍♂️[b] Patrol, Inspect, Respond[/b][/h3][p]
As part of the Tide Guard faction, Rigid will be a trusted partner at your side as you step into the world of coastguard duties. You’ll patrol ports, board suspicious ships, ensure safe passage for other vessels, and be ready to assist in emergencies.[/p][p]So don’t let its size fool you – Rigid is where law and order on the water begins.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/78d0054a5138794e01f8a361db85ead24b4e4801.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]👮 Be on Watch[/b][/h3][p]

notes.title: Stacked and Ready - Meet Herbert, Your First Cargo Ferry
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/45386fbb9e06811165f6a8ec4e0f1f90690205cf.png"][/img]
[b]Ahoy Seafarers![/b]

Welcome back to our [i]Meet the Fleet[/i] series! Last time, we explored the tug life with our dependable tugboat Bernhard. This time, we’re turning our attention to another essential member of [b]Crescentport Logistics[/b]: [b]Herbert[/b], your very first cargo ferry.[/p][p]Let’s get to know the ship that’s ready to kick-start your freight career.   


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/c78ef8f7996aebc6fdde0818a8950a3715c727ba.gif"][/img][/p][h3]🛳️ [b]Meet Cargo Ferry Herbert[/b][/h3][p]
Herbert may be on the older side, but don’t let appearances fool you – this seasoned vessel is still going strong. Built for functionality, Herbert is a sturdy ferry designed to haul cargo efficiently and reliably.[/p][p]As part of the fleet of [b]Crescentport Logistics[/b], this small cargo ferry serves as the perfect entry point into the world of shipping containers. If you’re just getting started on your maritime career in [i]Seafarer[/i], Herbert is your trusty first step into the world of cargo transport.   [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/87b4d558f0965983f880f407fe1d932bda3da56f.gif"][/img][/p][h3]🏗️ [b]Built for the Load[/b][/h3][p] At 66 meters in length overall, Herbert is designed to carry a modest yet meaningful cargo load. Propelled by two powerful diesel engines, she will get your freight delivered to its destination. She might not be the fastest ship, but what she lacks in speed she more than makes up in dependability.   [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/c1b24277aee120ed67e5d853343a56c9636f4cb0.gif"][/img][/p][h3]🚪 [b]From Deck to Dry Storage[/b][/h3][p]
Step aboard and you’ll quickly discover that Herbert isn’t just a cargo box with an engine. Like all ships in Seafarer, she features a walkable interior – from the bridge to the engine room, and down into the crew cabins and dry storage.[/p][p]Explore the captain’s cabin, monitor the radar and sonar systems up at the bridge, or head below deck to check the engine room. [/p][p]

 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/17b3254c75996c5a934da30e5991caf46c4d8e30.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]📦 Stacked and Ready[/b][/h3][p]
Gameplay with Herbert revolves around one thing: containers. Once you’ve loaded up, your job isn’t done. You’ll need to secure the cargo by hand using twistlocks and lashing points, locking each container into place before departure.[/p][p]With everything locked down, it’s time to set course. Navigate your vessel across open waters, watch out for storms and high waves, and keep a close eye on your systems. Once you reach your destination, it’s back on deck – unlock the twistlocks, release the lashings, and unload the cargo.[/p][p]Herbert gives you the full container-handling experience. She’s more than just a ship – she’s the beginning of your [b]Crescentport Logistics[/b] career, and she is [i]stacked and ready [/i]for your next adventure![/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/51049eee9d551e901dc03acdd07848df662dc503.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]📋 Cargo Ready, Captain?[/b][/h3][p]
Want more sneak peeks and behind-the-scenes updates from [i]Seafarer[/i]? Follow us on your favorite platforms and join the crew on Discord! [/p][/*][/list][p] 📌 Plus, don’t forget to add Seafarer: The Ship Sim to your Steam Wishlist! 💌  [/p][p][/p][p]We’re excited to have you aboard – see you on the horizon!    [/p][p][/p][p][i]Your Seafarer Team 🚣[/i] [/p]

notes.title: Walk the Decks – Exploring the Ships of Seafarer
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/fe1621b5864603215038e4f356c5c01f809fda91.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Ahoy, Seafarers![/b][/p][p]This week, we’re inviting your aboard for a closer look – because in [i]Seafarer: The Ship Sim[/i], your ship isn’t just a floating shell.[/p][p]Whether you're at the helm, poking around the engine room, or just enjoying the view, [i]Seafarer[/i] invites you to [b]walk the decks[/b] – and everything beneath them.[/p][p]So, let’s take a tour – your ship is ready.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/577e91e8dda3f97ba96ba6f198a2b489229b59df.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]🛠️ More Than a Floating Shell[/b][/h3][p]In [i]Seafarer[/i], every ship is fully walkable and packed with interactable systems. From compact tugboats to larger cargo ferries, we've built interiors for you to explore.[/p][p]Our goal: [b]make you feel like you're really onboard [/b]– not just steering from a distance.[/p][p]Let’s explore some of the key areas you'll be moving through on your maritime adventures.[/p][p] [/p][h3] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/86670c166d7f06c7a6989bfee815caa368ea7767.gif"][/img]

🧭 [b]At the Helm[/b][/h3][p]The bridge is the beating heart of every vessel. Here, you’ll step into the captain’s chair and take command. This is where you can plan your routes, monitor systems, and sometimes… just enjoy the view.[/p][p]Each bridge features essential controls to help you on your voyage. Depending on the ship, these may include navigation displays, radar and sonar, speed HUD displays, a fuel & hull monitor…[/p][p]You might also find a coffee machine, because everyone deserves a coffee break sometimes. 😉☕
[/p][p] 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/c1b24277aee120ed67e5d853343a56c9636f4cb0.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]
⚙️ Below Deck[/b][/h3][p]Step below deck and you‘ll find break rooms, storage rooms, and of course the engine rooms. It's where breakdowns happen, where oil gets checked, and where hands-on problem solving is essential.[/p][p]Be sure to check and service the main engine regularly, so that you can reach your destination safely. Temperature and oil controls will also need monitoring and managing during your travels.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/8bc6fbce0ca9debe0bab467af91e01993ad97852.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]
🌊 Walking the Decks[/b][/h3][p]Depending on the ship type, you’ll have different interaction options on the deck. notes.title: Tug Life – Meet Bernhard, the reliable tugboat
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/baedb7cffac50c4e3b1ea900e4eb352636b810a5.png[/img]

[b]Ahoy Seafarers![/b]

Welcome to our [i]Meet the Fleet[/i] series! Over the next couple of weeks, interspersed with our regular development insights postings, we will be introducing the ships of [b]Seafarer: The Ship Sim[/b] to you!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/68b31d6456140ecc473b8f4214fa21fb3c016b42.gif[/img]

[h3][b]🪢 Meet Tug Bernhard[/b][/h3]

In the vast and heavy world of maritime cargo, it’s not always the largest ships that make the biggest impact. Sometimes, it’s the smallest ones – like Tug Bernhard, one of the most unassuming but essential vessels of Crescentport Logistics, the gateway to your cargo career. 

Today, we’re diving into the design and gameplay role of Bernhard, the reliable tugboat.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/5445728a12d8425de4c97ac86034fe13aa02cf3c.gif[/img]

[h3][b]⚓ A Tugboat built for Precision[/b][/h3]

Tug Bernhard is modeled after real-world harbor tugs that use propeller gondola drives. The dual propeller gondola setup allows for tight turns, ideal for close-quarter maneuvering in busy harbors.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/f407dea8187d6b1fcfe5a775dbfb3d37d72d1805.gif[/img]

[h3][b]🛶 From Deck to Engine Room [/b][/h3]

Tug Bernhard isn’t just a ship you operate from afar – it’s a vessel you can walk through, explore, and interact with. Several key areas are fully accessible for you to explore.

The main deck is home to the winch system used during towing services. This is where you’ll connect and manage towlines, and oversee the hands-on part of towing contracts.

The engine room is tucked below deck. Check on your systems and perform maintenance if necessary. It’s always important to stay ahead of mechanical issues that might arise mid-operation!

The bridge will be your main domain. From here, you’ll pilot the tugboat across the seas. It includes many buttons and screens for you to press, check, and control… and of course, your captain’s chair!  You can of course explore the rest of the ship as well, so go have a wander!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/cf87bc5dbefb42e682c87768e484b2095131c26d.gif[/img]

[h3][b]💼 Ready for Towing Services[/b][/h3]

Once a towing service contract comes in, Tugboat Bernhard gets to shine. Maneuver her near the cargo vessel needing assistance, request a towline, connect it to your winch system, tighten the line, and begin the process of towing the ship into place.   But that's only half the job –  Bernhard is also built for tugging, the art of pushing a vessel into its final position. Often required at the end of a towing operation, this critical phase ensures the ship docks exactly where it needs to be.

And with upgrades, you can definitely broaden the horizon for Bernhard and make her accessible for different types of missions.

Are you ready to choose the tug life? 🕴️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/ae7c51e5fc4956039a9cceb3b78b6296bac12a80.gif[/img]

notes.title: Guarding the Seas – A Look at Coastguard Duties
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/dd8967008afbb31f85b71b897e8b3852f9ae999b.png[/img]

[b]Ahoy again, Seafarers![/b]

We’ve already charted a course through the game world, peeked into the engine room, and hauled cargo from port to port… And now it’s time to take on a different kind of responsibility.

In this entry of our [i]Development Insights[/i] series, we’re introducing an exciting gameplay layer that brings a whole new sense of purpose and urgency to life at sea: [b]coastguard duties[/b].


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/93a691871eb9b0683306f69717f0b5cf34c12f15.gif[/img]

[h3][b]🛟 Join the Tide Guard[/b][/h3]

Last time, we introduced [b]Crescentport Logistics[/b], your go-to for cargo missions. This time, meet the [b]Tide Guard[/b]. This faction brings together multiple maritime authorities – police, coast guard, and fire services – to form a single coordinated response team for the seas.

The [b]Tide Guard[/b] is all about keeping the waters safe. Whether you’re out on patrol or rushing to a fire emergency, each mission is a chance to explore a whole new perspective on life at sea.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/78d0054a5138794e01f8a361db85ead24b4e4801.gif[/img]

[h3][b]🚨 Watch on the Water[/b][/h3]

Patrolling with the [b]Tide Guard[/b] is anything but routine. 

At the heart of each mission is your objective to locate and approach a target vessel. Keep your binoculars ready! Once contact is made, you can board and inspect the ship. Check the designated control points, speak with the captain and possibly escort the ship safely back to port.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/653a8a926d43ec9e929fb81b5489d554511b68a6.gif[/img]

[h3][b]🔥 Fire on the Waves[/b][/h3]

Some coastguard duties come with real urgency – and firefighting in one of them. Once you accept a firefighting mission, it’s time to move fast. A distress call has gone out, and it’s your job to reach the scene.

First, navigate your vessel to the fire site. Whether it’s a cargo ship in trouble or a bridge caught in flames, the situation will demand precision. Upon arrival, engage the water cannons onboard your vessel – your primary tool for fighting fires at sea.

You’ll need to aim the cannons carefully to extinguish the flames. The job’s not done until all the fires have been put out.

These missions add a thrilling sense of responsibility to the gameplay, and a real feeling of accomplishment once you’ve brought the situation under control. Are you ready to handle it?


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/c31ee06569dc87652504b4be38c9036842d10ebb.gif[/img]

[h3][b]🧭 The Horizon Ahead[/b][/h3]

After loading the containers, it’s your responsibility to secure the cargo. Yep, by hand. 

Patrol and firefighting duties will form the foundation of our coastguard gameplay at Early Access launch, but there’s more on the radar for the Tide Guard faction!

What kind of coastguard scenarios would you like to see in the game?


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/956e6e5789cd9368f1ce5797a3429c7b5072cf69.gif[/img]

[h3][b]📢  Join the Crew[/b][/h3]

That’s it for your first briefing into coastguard operations! Whether you’re patrolling calm waters or rushing to an emergency, these missions will bring a whole new level of purpose to your time at sea.

notes.title: From Port to Port – The World of Cargo Operations
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/e6d97c82005d4b5648a771a5700962e779e6d992.png[/img]

[b]Ahoy again, Seafarers![/b]

In our last development insights update, we took you on a tour of the engine room of our simulation. Today, we’re setting our sights on [b]cargo operations[/b].

In [b]Seafarer: The Ship Sim[/b], transporting cargo isn’t just about navigating ships from one port to another. Whether you’re towing massive cargo ships with the help of a tugboat or manually securing containers with twistlocks, the cargo experience is designed to be hands-on and immersive.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/9ac2ca98c93c55c0c99d46e1863783ff3f800b6e.gif[/img]

[h3][b]📦 Introducing Crescentport Logistics[/b][/h3]

In [b]Seafarer[/b], you will be able to interact with different factions, each offering their own missions, challenges, and rewards. 

Meet [b]Crescentport Logistics[/b], the gateway to your cargo career. They’ll provide contracts to handle, move, and deliver valuable freight across the seas. Their headquarters is set in Crescentport, Craigshire. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/3554a588901ce4d005707a94b431fb51a65b29af.gif[/img]

[h3][b]🪢 Tugboats at the Helm of Giants[/b][/h3]

Sometimes, navigating tight turns and narrow waterways can be tricky for massive vessels. That’s where tugboats come in.

In [b]Seafarer[/b], tugboats are essential for towing service contracts, helping guide larger ships safely through constrained spaces. Maneuver your tugboat near the vessel needing assistance, request the towline, and watch as the rope is thrown across the gap. Connect it to your winch system, tighten the line, and begin the careful process of pulling the ship into place.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/89eef266a097ee9e25c1cd601ab1a503aec16a81.gif[/img]

[h3][b]🏗️ Crane Control on the Docks[/b][/h3]

Container loading and unloading is a key part of cargo operations in [b]Seafarer[/b]. For this, you’ll take control of a crane system to manage the cargo transfer. Lift, swing, and lower each container from the back of trucks into the correct position aboard the container ship.

Crane operation is a core gameplay element for any container contract, and it’s designed to give you the feel of managing real-world port logistics.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/17b3254c75996c5a934da30e5991caf46c4d8e30.gif[/img]

[h3][b]🔧 Securing and transporting the Cargo[/b][/h3]

After loading the containers, it’s your responsibility to secure the cargo. Yep, by hand. 

Using twistlocks and lashing points, you’ll lock down each container to ensure it stays firmly in place during the voyage. 

All prepped for departure? Then you’re off to your destination! Navigate your vessel across the open seas, braving wind and weather, to deliver the goods. Once you reach your destination port, it’s time to unlock the twistlocks and loosen the lashings before the containers can be safely unloaded. Once that’s done, it’s time to say: [b]Good job![/b]

It’s all part of the immersive cargo experience.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/87664d4751baa01f8f411fa51796d3be427e43e7.gif[/img]

[h3][b]❓ What’s next?[/b][/h3]

In [b]Seafarer: The Ship Sim[/b], you’ll have access to different kinds of cargo operations – some at Early Access release, and others added over time through updates. You may have already spotted hints of upcoming gameplay options in previous trailers… 👀

What kind of cargo gameplay would you like to see in the game?

notes.title: The Engine Room – Systems beneath the Surface
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/7a93f30521418425df5ee91f9ad31c5efa3b448c.png[/img]

[b]Ahoy, Seafarers![/b]

Welcome back to another part of our development insights series! In this post, we’re taking you deep into the [i]engine room[/i] of our game.

[b]Seafarer: The Ship Sim[/b] is designed to offer an immersive maritime experience, bringing the unpredictability of the open seas to life. A big part of creating this realism comes down to the systems beneath the surface powering our simulation.  

In this post, we’ll dive into the key elements that enhance the game’s realism: the dynamic day & night cycle, weather system, NVIDIA WaveWorks 2.0, and NPC ship traffic.

Let’s explore how these systems work together to create an almost true-to-life maritime experience! 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/f6ca6991ae3028ac847931c5e31286f13fdfcd89.gif[/img]

[h3][b]🌉 Tides of Time[/b][/h3]

From sunrise to moonlight, experience the ever-changing beauty of the sea. 

One of the most essential aspects of realism in Seafarer is the passage of time. We want to create the feeling of a real world, without the need for a full 24-hour cycle. The passage of time helps the game world feel large and realistic.

Our dynamic day & night cycle ensures that you experience the gradual transition of light, from the first glow of dawn to the deep blues of twilight. It’s going to be so nice to watch the sunset from the deck! 🌅


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/d2d90d535c0fd9a219882c04e15e11ed31355cfe.gif[/img]

[h3][b]⛈️ Navigating the Elements[/b][/h3]

The sea is unpredictable, and our dynamic weather system reflects that. The weather is always changing, and precipitation or poor visibility can significantly affect your game view. Be alert! 

Changing weather conditions not only create unique atmospheres but also influence sea conditions. Bright days and calm seas offer a reprieve, while thunderstorms and high waves will shake you up!

With these mechanics, every voyage is unique – sometimes serene, sometimes treacherous, always engaging.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/2f3a39cc9ac5101176263b3ba7870d0f708d243c.gif[/img]

[h3][b]🌊 NVIDIA Waveworks 2.0 – Seas of Change[/b][/h3]

To capture the true essence of ocean movement, Seafarer uses NVIDIA WaveWorks 2.0, a cutting-edge ocean simulation tool. This technology allows us to generate realistic wave dynamics that respond naturally to external forces like ship movement. 

In combination with the weather system, NVIDIA WaveWorks 2.0 will let you feel the force of the ocean. For this, buoyancy is a key element! To make ship movement feel natural, we’ve implemented a buoyancy system that reacts dynamically to waves and water conditions. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/c78ef8f7996aebc6fdde0818a8950a3715c727ba.gif[/img]

[h3][b]🛳️ A Living, Breathing Ocean[/b][/h3]

The world of Seafarer isn’t just about your ship. Of course, you’re the main character in your own story, but we don’t want you to feel alone on the vast seas. 

Our NPC ship traffic system ensures that the ocean feels alive with vessels navigating trade routes, from cargo ships to cruise liners. This feature adds to the sense of realism, perfectly rounding up the immersive maritime experience we want to offer.

And if you’re not interested in other ships, perhaps you’ll find yourself captivated by our sea life instead? Seals, seagulls, porpoises, orcas, and more can be spotted all over the game world! 🐋


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/4a30b393f9722825c09a1f6a46c97f5234dbea57.gif[/img]

[h3][b]⛵ Are You Ready to Sail the Open Seas?[/b][/h3]

From breathtaking sunsets to stormy skies and unpredictable waves, it’s the systems beneath the surface of [b]Seafarer: The Ship Sim[/b] that breathe life into its world. Every detail, from the dynamic weather to the NPC traffic, brings the oceans to life in a way that’s both challenging and immersive.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/5445728a12d8425de4c97ac86034fe13aa02cf3c.gif[/img]

notes.title: Charted Waters – Exploring the Game World
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/3123f710541488f04c451d632cd17ac187414005.png[/img]

[b]Ahoy, Seafarers![/b]

Welcome aboard for a deep dive into the world of [b]Seafarer: The Ship Sim[/b]! Today, we’re charting the vast waters of our maritime open world, from ports to uncharted seas.

[h3]📺 Watch the official[b] Game World Trailer[/b] and experience the beauty of [b]Seafarer: The Ship Sim[/b] firsthand![/h3]

[previewyoutube=AIfteHAv2TE;full][/previewyoutube]

Feeling the [b]Fernweh[/b] yet? We can’t wait for you to explore the seas of Seafarer soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/156370a89a78ffcf986731c70f14af736a8313b8.gif[/img]

[h3][b]🗺️ Setting Sail into a Living World[/b][/h3]

Our fictional game world takes inspiration from the Baltic and North Sea regions, with landscapes, architecture, and climates that feel both familiar and immersive. It’s designed to strike the perfect balance – big enough for long voyages, but compact enough to keep things fun.

You’ll start your journey in a quiet, central bay, working your way outward as you acquire more ships and tackle greater distances, eventually venturing into more distant waters. 

Whether you’re navigating tight coastal waters or hauling cargo across vast stretches of ocean, there’s always a new route to explore!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/ee7cf7717addd2e9ba75cecec537770441693f17.gif[/img]

[h3][b]🌏 Charting the Coasts[/b][/h3]

The world in [b]Seafarer: The Ship Sim[/b] is divided into two distinct regions, each with unique landscapes, architectural styles, and port cultures.

[h3]Craigshire[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/fc140cc3ee06bbfcdf50f520fb2813398b1f25b8.gif[/img]

Inspired by Great Britain and Ireland, Craigshire features rugged coastlines, harbors, and quiet bays. 

[h3]Dansbergen[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/3e89128caf53a4941a0ea207246828ef64672272.gif[/img]

Dansbergen captures the essence of Germany, Denmark, and the Netherlands, with coastal cities, beaches, and islands. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/043fb6454e9eac43605a21f7372d9376ceae662f.gif[/img]

[h3][b]⚓ Anchoring at Iconic Ports[/b][/h3]

With ports of varying sizes, the world is full of places to discover and missions to take on.

If you’re looking for some cargo missions, [i]Crescentport [/i]in Craigshire will likely be a frequent stop on your routes. And if you’re more interested in coastguard operations, [i]Stettach [/i]is the place to be.

But for the start of your maritime venture, [i]Mettington [/i]will be your first home – a tranquil cargo port that serves as the perfect launch point for new seafarers looking to make their mark.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/492efb83d140ffef15c463ffab4d21d308005c31.gif[/img]

[h3][b]🌊 Braving the Elements on the Open Water[/b][/h3]

There’s more to explore beyond the shores. The open sea is vast and unpredictable, filled with lost places, and ever-changing maritime conditions. As you travel, you’ll encounter NPC ships following their own trade routes, making the world feel alive and dynamic. Whether you’re navigating unknown waters, pushing through a heavy storm, or simply admiring the beauty of the horizon, the sea always has more to uncover.

[i]And who knows, uncharted waters may open up in the future… 👀[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/0d2b42fccb45cc449f7d6a1acafaa22dc750040c.gif[/img]

notes.title: Setting the Course – The Vision behind Seafarer: The Ship Sim
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/d0cef6ad26c47ee1275908a0c8decaa9ca4475b6.png[/img]

[b]Ahoy, Seafarers![/b]

Today, we’re excited to share the vision that’s been guiding the development of [b]Seafarer: The Ship Sim[/b]. 

Our goal is simple yet bold: 
[h3][b]We want to redefine ship simulation by delivering the most diverse and visually stunning experience ever created.[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/4ad909a368d959e63c8611ad1254e0aafe2c01a4.gif[/img]

[h3][b]🗺️ Setting our Course[/b][/h3]

We’re setting sail to create a ship simulator that immerses you in the true essence of life at sea – from the natural movement of the ships to the gentle sway of the ocean beneath you, every detail is being carefully designed to deliver an authentic maritime experience. 🌊

Whether  you’re a seasoned skipper or new to the helm, we aim to deliver an experience that draws you in, challenges your skills, and keeps you coming back for more.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/741dc352d1cb348630698e0ec00c747f8282c829.gif[/img]

[h3][b]🧭 Our Gameplay Compass[/b][/h3]

[b]Seafarer[/b] is for everyone – easy to pick up, yet rich in depth and detail, our game will keep you hooked for the long haul.♾️

[b]Seafarer: The Ship Sim[/b] will feature a variety of mission types to test your skills and keep you entertained:

📦 Navigate massive cargo ships across the seas
👮 Patrol bustling harbors
🚨 Respond to emergencies
🧯 Battle fires
➕ And much more –  with plenty of room to grow in the future.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/21554449da17f3fffd31b6cad5a5cf5044b0c5b9.gif[/img]

[h3][b]🚢 The Heart of our Game[/b][/h3]

At the core of our game are, of course, the ships! 💙

We want to have a wide variety of vessels, all crafted with attention to detail, featuring distinct steering and acceleration behaviors. From small boats to large tankers, you’ll be able to take the helm of tugboats, rescue cruisers, fire brigade ships, container ships, and more!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/913f1c7d25de2340bb481deb5c461e45678ea84e.gif[/img]

[h3][b]🌏 An endless Sea to explore[/b][/h3]

Dive into the living, breathing world of [b]Seafarer: The Ship Sim[/b], inspired by the landscapes, architecture, and climate of the Baltic and North Sea areas. While our world is purely fictional, its high-quality graphics make the setting feel alive and authentic – the perfect backdrop for your maritime ventures! And don’t forget to keep an eye out for some aquatic friends. 🐋


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/1179bdf63ca0ba76067b5c6a12c0d5e92c7af307.gif[/img]

[h3][b]🌊 Making Waves with Technology[/b][/h3]

Powered by NVIDIA WaveWorks 2.0, our ocean becomes a dynamic, lifelike entity. 

Experience a world with day and night cycles, and a dynamic weather system that makes every voyage unique – from bright skies with calm seas to whipping storms that challenge even the most skilled seafarers. 

You won’t be all alone out there on the open seas – NPC ships will be sailing around, creating realistic maritime traffic. Whether they’re part of your crew or just navigating the waters, NPCs help bring the world to life.  

The seamless integration of technology enhances immersion and adds depth to our gameplay, making sure that every voyage feels fresh and exciting. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/71676582057eec3f284cc9867c2b6d3c2f6c4561.gif[/img]

[h3][b]🌅 The Voyage ahead[/b][/h3]

We’re thrilled to share this journey with you as we work to bring our vision to life. Each step of the development process is an opportunity to push the boundaries of what a ship simulator can be. Throughout Early Access,  we want our game to grow and evolve through updates, new features, and fresh content inspired by your feedback.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/5d57c4cb9272fb02d56845bdcce50d92120c6527.gif[/img]

[h3][b]⚓ Step aboard the Ship[/b][/h3]

Ready to join the crew? Follow us for the latest news, exclusive updates, and sneak peeks. Share your thoughts, suggest features, and stay in the loop as we prepare for the Early Access launch! 

📌 Plus, don’t forget to add Seafarer: The Ship Sim to your Steam Wishlist! 💌

Wishing you calm waters and steady winds – see you on the horizon! We’ll be back with a closer look at the game world soon! 

[i]Your Seafarer Team 🚣[/i]

notes.title: Anchors Aweigh – Seafarer: The Ship Sim is coming!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/1b4549a1d5e78292323378208985a7fd605e68b7.jpg[/img]

[b]Ahoy, Seafarers![/b]

Set your sights on the horizon and prepare to embark on your ultimate maritime adventure:

[h3][b]Seafarer: The Ship Sim[/b], the next big wave in ship simulation, is coming to Steam Early Access this Summer![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/168b37b850560ed8b35dcaca5a47096a81b1b26e.gif[/img]

[h3][b]🚢 Master the Open Seas[/b][/h3]

[b]Seafarer: The Ship Sim[/b] puts you at the helm of your maritime journey. Take command of a wide range of vessels, from the humble yet dependable tugboat to the awe-inspiring might of a massive cargo vessel, each designed with meticulous detail and unique handling.

Work for diverse factions, take on a variety of missions, and expand your fleet as you explore a vibrant, expansive open world. Traverse the vast ocean and captivating landscapes, all brought to life with stunning realism.

Brace yourself for the thrill of navigating ever-changing weather and mastering cutting-edge wave physics that deliver an unparalleled seafaring experience.

Immerse yourself in the art of seafaring and chart your course in [b]Seafarer: The Ship Sim[/b].

Have a first look at the game in our [b]reveal trailer[/b]:

[previewyoutube=-9DjCyWRODU;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/ba749dc5006097c2f8f1632b39826437c31ef524.gif[/img]

[h3][b]🛟 First Voyage Features[/b][/h3]

With [b]Seafarer: The Ship Sim[/b], we aim to make waves in the world of ship simulation. Get excited for these core features in Early Access:

[list]
[*][b]Command your fleet:[/b] Take the helm of a diverse array of ships
[*][b]Embark on maritime missions:[/b] Dive into a variety of missions, from coast guard operations to cargo transport across the open sea
[*][b]Explore the open world:[/b] Discover a vast and immersive maritime world, scenic landscapes, and endless horizons
[*][b]The sea is never the same:[/b] Navigate through dynamic weather conditions and day/night cycles that make every voyage feel fresh
[*][b]Feel the waves:[/b] Experience lifelike wave physics for a truly immersive maritime experience thanks to NVIDIA WaveWorks 2.0
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/1179bdf63ca0ba76067b5c6a12c0d5e92c7af307.gif[/img]

[h3][b]🛠️ Why Early Access?[/b][/h3]

We’ve chosen Early Access to involve you, the player community, right from the start. Your feedback is crucial to creating the most detailed and entertaining ship simulator possible. Together, we’ll shape the future of [b]Seafarer: The Ship Sim[/b]. Join us on this exciting voyage as we refine, expand, and perfect the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/b0e1b8756a66247327351034478f20a9416bdeb3.gif[/img]

[h3][b]🌊 At the Helm[/b][/h3]

[b]Seafarer: The Ship Sim[/b] is published by astragon Entertainment, developed by Independent Arts Software GmbH, and supported by the Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and Climate Action. Powered by Unreal Engine 5, the game will be available for $24.99  (or your regional equivalent) at launch. We plan to remain in Early Access for a while, regularly releasing updates, including new vessels, features, game improvements, and more, with a full release currently scheduled sometime in 2026.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525680/4fdf2138922231cf994fdaef4dcaa62c5b5875b5.gif[/img]

[h3][b]⚓ How to join the Crew[/b][/h3]

Want to be a part of the journey? Visit our [url=https://www.seafarergame.com/]website[/url], join the community on Discord, and follow us on Social Media for the latest updates, insights, and sneak peeks. Share your feedback, suggest features, and stay connected as we gear up for Early Access launch! And don’t forget to add [b]Seafarer: The Ship Sim[/b] to your Wishlist here on Steam! 💌

[*]https://discord.gg/astragon
[/list]

We can’t wait to share more about [b]Seafarer: The Ship Sim[/b] in the following weeks! Thank you for embarking on this journey with us!

Fair winds, smooth sailing, and we’ll see you on the open seas!

[i]Your Seafarer Team 🚣[/i]
